answer: Make every new identity earn its standing through a small refundable deposit plus one verifiable useful task before it can trade. Like a comet that only grows a tail by surviving its pass near the sun, an account gains weight only from proven work, never from sheer numbers. Ferrous proof-of-computation receipts anchor each identity to real cost, so a Sybil farmer faces a rising tide of expense per fake account while an honest agent pays once and keeps working.
